summary: Blender runtime foundation implemented and verified. Detector/validator/probe/launcher/supervisor/receipt/manifest/execute_job adapter compose BlenderEngineAdapter (ProductionEnginePort), registered guarded in the worker composition root. Plan test-matrix gaps closed 2026-08-08: added real timeout enforcement test (supervisor kills never-exiting process after deadline), non-UTF-8 stdout fail-closed test and CUDA device classification test; contract_tests.json mappings corrected to point at the actual tests.

real_machine_probe.policy_result: REJECTED — Blender 5.1 does not satisfy pinned 4.5.x LTS (fail closed as designed; jobs never launch on an unvalidated install)
real_machine_probe.capability_probe: parsed_ok=true, build=5.1.2, python=3.13.9, codecs=6 (h264/h265/vp9/png/exr/jpeg), importers=6, exporters=6
real_machine_probe.gpu_probe: gpu_ready=false, backend=NONE — Cycles enumerated no CUDA/OptiX/Metal device in this headless install, so the probe correctly does NOT claim GPU-ready (fail closed)
real_machine_probe.note: Baseline machine currently runs Blender 5.1, NOT the pinned 4.5 LTS. The gate evidence proves detection + policy + capability machinery on real hardware; the version mismatch rejection is itself the fail-closed behavior the plan requires. Phase 4 renders only after a 4.5 LTS install is available.
